title: The scalar-restricted module-sheafification unit and its extension
statement: Let C be a category, J a topology, R and S commutative rings, r:R→S, and a:T→U a morphism of ring sheaves. Let α:const(R)→T and β:const(S)→U be locally bijective presentations with const(r)≫β=α≫a, and suppose abelian sheafification exists with its usual local equivalence criterion. For an S-module presheaf P, restrict the β-sheafification unit along r and along α,a; extend this R-linear presheaf map by the α-module-sheafification adjunction. This defines rawMap(P):sh_α(Res_r(P))→Res_a(sh_β(P)). Its underlying morphism of abelian sheaves is the identity of the common abelian sheafification of P.

source.place: The module-sheafification adjunction, its forgetful hom-equivalence formulas and unit; the scalar-composition isomorphism of ModuleCat.

proof.text: The component is the β-sheafification unit on underlying elements. Its R-linearity follows by evaluating const(r)≫β=α≫a on a section; naturality is naturality of that unit. Extend this map by sheafificationHomEquiv(α). The forgetful formulas for the unit and hom-equivalence identify its abelian adjunct with toSheafify. The sheafification adjunction unit formula and injectivity of its hom-equivalence then identify the extended underlying sheaf map with the identity.
